info.title: WhatsApp Cloud API Control Center
info.description:
REST API for managing WhatsApp Business Platform assets through the Meta Graph API.

**Authentication:** session cookies (`wacc_at` access, `wacc_rt` refresh) issued by `/auth/login`.
State-changing requests must come from the web app origin.

**Errors:** every error uses the `ApiError` schema. Graph API failures include a normalized `meta` object.

**Pagination:** list endpoints return `{ items, nextCursor }`; pass `cursor` to continue.

wabaId.description: waba_id from the WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP message event.

verifiedName.description: Display name. Meta reviews it against the display name guidelines.

pin.description: Existing two-step verification PIN, or a new one if none is set.

dataLocalizationRegion.description: Local storage region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), if required by regulation.

payload.description: Object for the selected type, exactly as in the Cloud API (`text`, `template`, `image`...).

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.

related.description: Other entries with the same request ID (inbound call and the Meta calls it made).

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.

acceptUrl.description: Shown once. Share it with the invitee; only its hash is stored.

webhook.description: Per-connection webhook endpoint (manual connections with their own app).
